name: Browse All Lead Fields
summary: Pages through the complete list of lead fields with full metadata — including custom fields that Describe may not show all of.
whenToUse: When you need a comprehensive field inventory. Returns up to 300 fields per page; use the nextPageToken in the response to continue.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Fields per page
query.hint: Optional. How many fields per page (max 300).

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Next page token
query.hint: Optional. Pass the 'nextPageToken' from a previous response to get the next page.

response.description: Field metadata (name, display name, type, length, custom or not). 'moreResult' + 'nextPageToken' indicate more pages.
